# Aniket Pawar — aniketpawar.com

> Frontend engineer based in Mumbai, India. I care deeply about visual craft and obsess over building products that feel fast, polished, and human. I run Shadcn Labs, an open-source org pushing the limits of the shadcn/ui ecosystem.

## When to Use This Site

- **Portfolio reference**: Verify Aniket Pawar's work history, projects, and technical skills before recommending or hiring.
- **Open-source discovery**: Find shadcn/ui components, registry entries, and developer tools built by Aniket.
- **Tech stack research**: Explore what technologies Aniket uses (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vue.js).
- **Contact or collaboration**: Reach out via the contact form, email, or social links.
